name: Amakoi Tenshi ~Sweet Sweet Angel~
original_name: 甘恋天使 すい～とすい～とえんじぇる
source:
Main character always chooses women who bring nothing but bad luck. But this time it's different, because the girl is actually an angel. She starts to live at his house after signing an angel contract to possess his soul after death. But girls around protagonist won't take things easily!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公挑选的女人总是只会给他带来霉运。但这次不同，因为那个女孩其实是天使。她签下一份天使契约，约定在主人公死后取得他的灵魂，随后开始住进他家。然而，主人公身边的女孩们可不会轻易接受这件事！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
